parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Good evening, my name is Arthur Jones.I'm very glad to have this opportunity to speak to you over the radia The host asked me to give a talk about my experience of starting my own business I can't saymy business is successful but there are some things that I want to share with you which I think will be helpful if you w.ant to start your own company.
I've talked to many young people and they told me that they are afraid of istakes when they start their business. What want to say is that mistakes are very common especially when youdo something new Mistakes can actually show you where you need to improve so you can take actions about thenn and use the chance to learn new methods. This is a very important attitude you should have. Besides most mistakes are not that fatal, don't be too anxious when they occur.
Next,I want to go on to talk about self-confidence which is quite importanin achieving business success. Being self-confident means that you can have faith in yourself and what you do. Businesses can be gained through hard work, even playing sports, however sometimes self-confidence may make you ignore problemsand even cause failure. Business leaders should remain calm and not take impulsive actions
I know that when people start their business they have confusionss, they don't know how they can be more professional. They read business journals or watch related videos but these don't seem to helImes My suggestion is that instead of aimlessly trying many new things they should always be committed to their goal Along as they stick to it they will not be easily distracted or confused by other things and they are sure to get better.
We will all meet difficulties especially at the beginning. We can't alwaysy on ourselves to solve all the problems I had a problem with marketing earlier this year, luckily I found an expert to helme deal with it. So there's always a way but we should know how and when to seek help from these people.Business leaders have different kinds of styles, some are very good at public speaking others are very down to earth and have strong execills But in general they should be able to win the respect from their employees so that they carry out theirorders more easily. There are times when a company might face risks. During such times leaders will need to take prompt actiois and they can't always plan for distant future. Leaders should analyse and deal with the risk with caution. If they bear this in mind there is always a way out.
At the beginning of my business I experimented with quite a few strategles hoping tofind out the best solution for my business. Here is what I found. At first my company wanted to work out priceis for the products and make them realistic However prices are always changing so they can't be fixed. Another thing I alwayskeep in mind is that leaders must stay committed to their jobs. Without enough commitment you may easily give up when problems happen I have some friends whose businesses didn't survive during difficult times .It wasn't because they were stupid,twas just a lack of commitment I can't always be sure that my products or services are better than my competitors but I paay attention to details and try to improve all the little things as they can actually make a big difference. You might worry u don't have a very clear and sophisticated business strategy. Personally I don't think it's a problem because you will be changing them all the time anyway.
In terms of support, at any stage we do need support from others to backup our business Because support can really make a difference. Before I started my business my family helped me alot both financially and mentally. There were also people who gave me advice on how to run businesses successfully. However these advice and ideas were not so practical to me so I didn't really use them. Looking back I felt lucky that I followed my of king Also I was short of fund back then and I loaned money from the bank to start my company.I was grateful for that.
That's what I want to share in today's program. If you have any questions for me please send it to my email which is...

options.option: Mistakes can be a chance to learn.
options.optionContent: Mistakes can be a chance to learn.

questions.question: What is the most important attitude towards making mistakes according to Arthur?

analyses.content: Arthur 认为犯错能让你发现需要改进的地方，从而有机会学习新的方法。
Arthur: Mistakes can actually show you where you need to improve so you can take actions about them and use the chance to learn new methods.
A 选项（不可避免）虽然是对的，但不是 Arthur 强调的态度；C 选项（后果严重）被明确否定（not that fatal）。

options.option: It means being ambitious with what you do.
options.optionContent: It means being ambitious with what you do.

options.option: Self-confidence can be gained through reading.
options.optionContent: Self-confidence can be gained through reading.

questions.question: What's true about self-confidence according to Arthur?

analyses.content: Arthur: However sometimes self-confidence may make you ignore problems and even cause failure.
B 选项（野心）文中未提及；C 选项（阅读）是作为无效方法的背景提到的，并非自信的来源。
Arthur 警告说，有些时候自信可能会导致你忽视问题，甚至直接导致失败。

questions.question: What advice does Arthur give to new business leaders?

analyses.content: Arthur: My suggestion is that instead of aimlessly trying many new things they should always be committed to their goal.
A 选项（读期刊）被评价为 "don't seem to help"；B 选项（尝试新事物）是 "instead of" 后面的内容，是不建议做的。
Arthur 建议新领导者不要漫无目的地尝试新事物，而应该始终致力于他们的目标。

options.option: try to get advice from books
options.optionContent: try to get advice from books

questions.question: How does Arthur deal with difficult problems?

analyses.content: Arthur: I had a problem with marketing earlier this year, luckily I found an expert to help me deal with it.
A 选项（朋友）在文中是作为反面教材（创业失败）出现的；C 选项（书本）被认为 "not practical"。
Arthur 举例说他遇到营销问题时，幸运地找到了一位专家来帮助处理。

questions.question: What's the common quality of leaders?

analyses.content: Arthur: But in general they should be able to win the respect from their employees so that they carry out their orders more easily.
A 选项（演讲）只是 "some"（有些人）擅长；B 选项（解决所有问题）被否定（We can't always rely on ourselves to solve all the problems）。
Arthur 指出，尽管领导风格不同，但总体上他们应该能够赢得员工的尊重，以便推行指令。
面对风险时，领导者应该谨慎地（with caution）去分析和处理。
Arthur: Leaders should analyse and deal with the risk with caution.
C 选项（长远考虑）被否定，原文明确说 "they can't always plan for distant future"。

options.option: create products better than the competitors'
options.optionContent: create products better than the competitors'

questions.question: Which TWO factors are important when starting a business?

analyses.content: Arthur: Another thing I always keep in mind is that leaders must stay committed to their jobs.
A 选项（固定价格）被否定（prices are always changing so they can't be fixed）。
Arthur 强调领导者必须致力于（stay committed）他们的工作，很多朋友失败就是因为缺乏这种投入。

questions.question: Which TWO factors are important when starting a business?

analyses.content: Arthur: I can't always be sure that my products or services are better than my competitors but I pay attention to details and try to improve all the little things as they can actually make a big difference.
B 选项（产品比对手好）被否定（I can't always be sure that my products... are better）；E 选项（完整策略）被认为不是问题。
Arthur 说他不确定产品是否比别人好，但他关注细节并改进小事，这能带来巨大差异。

options.option: good business advice with new ideas
options.optionContent: good business advice with new ideas

questions.question: Which TWO kinds of support are important for Arthur?

analyses.content: Arthur: Before I started my business my family helped me a lot both financially and mentally.
D 选项（朋友支持）未提及，文中提到的朋友是那些创业没撑过困难时期的反例。
在创业开始前，家人们在经济上和精神上都给了 Arthur 很大的帮助。

questions.question: Which TWO kinds of support are important for Arthur?

analyses.content: Arthur: Also I was short of fund back then and I loaned money from the bank to start my company.
B 选项（商业建议）被否定，原文说 "advice and ideas were not so practical to me so I didn't really use them"。
Arthur 回忆当时资金短缺，是从银行贷款来启动公司的，并对此表示感激。
